notes:
### Dorcel Stall Minimization

- Confirmed Dorcel 404/timeout outages now pre-resolve a validated shadow website session after a short confirmation window, so a browser-style fresh session can be ready before Kodi needs it.
- If a validated shadow session is playable while Kodi is visibly stalled or the active cache has already fallen to zero, Adult TV Test can use the existing clean Stop -> idle -> Start handoff immediately instead of waiting for the 30-second fallback.

### Post-Recovery Health Check

- When the original Dorcel source returns first, Kodi now gets only a 2.5-second health grace. Continued OutputPicture stalls, low cache or playback lag trigger a switch to the prepared shadow session, while genuinely healthy short recoveries remain restart-free.
- This targets long Kodi tail stalls after the website/source is already healthy again, while avoiding unnecessary restarts for brief recoveries.

### Diagnostics

- Final Dorcel summaries now include shadow-session prepared/used counters and post-recovery natural/reopen counters.
- Mixed source + Kodi tail evidence is retained so long source stalls followed by Kodi-only recovery delay are no longer treated as purely SOURCE_WINDOW events.

### Important

- Normal HTTP-200 SOURCE_WINDOW handling and the planned hourly Dorcel token handoff remain unchanged.
- Existing clean recovery, Wi-Fi diagnostics, outage counters, Auto Channels Check, Site/IPTV behavior, One Channel, automatic log saving, Save Log Only, Shutdown/Sleep, Check Lock and watchdog remain otherwise unchanged.
